title: SkyCheck
description:
An offline-first PWA for site inspectors to perform AI-powered safety audits of heavy machinery in low-connectivity industrial environments.

📷 Real-time edge AI inference — classifies Corrosion, Cracks, and Normal via camera feed directly in-browser
📶 Offline-first with Dexie.js (IndexedDB) — full audit capability with zero connectivity
🔄 Online sync — cascading ID reconciliation pushes local records to PostgreSQL on Railway
🔐 JWT auth + OTP-based password recovery via SMTP
🤖 AI maintenance brief generation — Gemini-powered narrative inspection reports
👥 Co-developed with Riya Gupta (CSBS)
longDescription:
SkyCheck — AI-Powered Visual Structural Inspection Assistant
SkyCheck enables site inspectors and heavy machinery operators to perform rapid, repeatable safety audits in low-connectivity or offline industrial environments. Using a smartphone camera, the system performs real-time edge anomaly classification directly inside the browser, stores inspections in a local sync queue, synchronizes with a central PostgreSQL database when online, and generates AI narrative maintenance briefs.

🔗 Live Application URLs
Live PWA Frontend (Vercel): https://dist-five-gules-45.vercel.app
Live API Backend (Railway): https://backend-production-a67b6.up.railway.app
Backend Health / Demo Authenticator: https://backend-production-a67b6.up.railway.app/api/auth/demo
🏗️ Architecture & Technology Stack

1. Frontend: React PWA (Vite 8 & Tailwind CSS v4)
Offline First: Service worker caching and PWA manifests enable full app launch and camera functions without active internet connection.
Client Cache: Powered by Dexie.js (IndexedDB v2 schema) with auto-incrementing IDs for local creations.
Dynamic visual effects: Features advanced mouse-following border glows, 3D card tilt, particle systems, and hardware-accelerated aurora waves.
Edge Inference & Heuristic Assist: Runs defect classification on camera feeds. Integrates real-time canvas pixel scanners (color ratio, contrast edge line, shadow/specular highlights) to boost anomaly detection accuracy.
2. Backend: Spring Boot 3.5 & PostgreSQL
JPA & Hibernate Persistence: Schema and data initialization mapped cleanly for heavy industrial assets.
Security & Password Recovery: Gated API routes with stateless JWT tokens, SignUp controls, and an SMTP OTP verification engine.
Cascading ID Reconciliation: Restores local auto-increment IDs to central database primary keys upon synchronization.
📋 Step-by-Step Demo Instructions
1. Register a New Profile
Navigate to the Live PWA Frontend.
Click SignUp Profile at the bottom of the login card.
Fill in the registry form (Name, Username, Email, Role, and Passcode) and submit to create your profile and log in.
2. Verify Passcode Recovery (Forgot Password OTP)
Log out. Click Forgot Passcode? on the login page.
Enter the registered email address and submit.
Open your Railway project's backend logs (in the Railway dashboard) and locate the printed verification code: ========================================== OTP CODE FOR username@email.com IS: XXXXXX ==========================================
Enter the OTP code in the app, choose a new passcode, and confirm you can log in with the new credentials.
3. Test Camera Accuracy (Heuristics)
Select any machinery and click Start Inspection. Allow camera permissions.
Corrosion check: Point the camera at a rusted surface, brown box, or orange object -> the classifier dynamically detects color chroma and tags Corrosion.
Crack check: Point the camera at a blank paper with a bold black line -> the classifier detects high-contrast lines and tags Crack.
Point at a normal surface -> the classifier resets to Normal.
4. Manage Fleet Assets Offline
On the Dashboard, click Register Asset. Add a machine (e.g. Volvo Loader, Model L150, Serial VO-992).
Toggle Developer Tools (F12) -> Network -> Offline. The header shows OFFLINE WORKSPACE.
Click on the new machine card. Click Add Component to register custom safety checkpoints (e.g. Engine Fan Belt).
Click Start Inspection to run the safety audit offline. Save it.
In the machine details, click Delete next to any component to remove it "one by one", or click Decommission Asset to delete the machine.
Toggle connection back to Online -> click Sync Now. Local changes sync instantly to PostgreSQL on Railway, executing cascading ID maps.
👥 Project Team & Contributors
This project was co-developed by a two-member team from the CSBS (Computer Science and Business Systems) department:

Priyanshu Ghosh (CSBS)
Riya Gupta (CSBS)
⚠️ Known Limitations & Disclaimers
Free-Tier SMTP / Logs Fallback: To support a 100% free deploy, the mail sender service falls back to logging generated security codes directly to the server logs if active SMTP mail credentials are not provided.
Camera Simulator: Standard boundary boxes are rendered dynamically around detected pixel segments to provide visual inspector feedback.
Bypass Access: Quick demo login buttons bypass REST auth queries using preset accounts for judging convenience.

title: ZeroHour — AI Productivity Companion
description: 🚨 ZeroHour — AI-powered last-minute productivity companion | Built for Hackathon By CodingNinjas × Google (Vibe2Ship)
longDescription:
When you're about to miss a deadline, you don't need a reminder — you need a plan.

ZeroHour is a full-stack multi-agent AI system that actively plans, prioritizes, schedules, and nudges users before deadlines are missed. The hero feature, Panic Mode, lets users describe a crisis in natural language and receive a complete AI-generated action plan pushed directly to Google Calendar.

🤖 4-Agent AI Pipeline:
• Planner Agent — Gemini 2.5 Flash decomposes goals into time-boxed subtasks
• Prioritizer Agent — Ranks by urgency × impact (CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW)
• Scheduler Agent — Creates real Google Calendar events via Calendar API v3
• Nudge Agent — Spring @Scheduled cron sends proactive email + in-app alerts at 24h, 6h, 1h

🛠 Tech Stack:
Backend: Java 17 + Spring Boot 3.x | Spring Security OAuth2 | AES-256 encryption
Frontend: React 18 + Vite + Tailwind CSS | Framer Motion | Server-Sent Events (SSE)
AI: Gemini 2.5 Flash (Google AI Studio)
Data: Firebase Firestore | Google OAuth 2.0
Infra: Docker (multi-stage) | Firebase Hosting | Google Cloud Run

🔗 Google Technologies: Gemini 2.5 Flash · AI Studio · OAuth 2.0 · Calendar API v3 · Gmail API · Firebase Firestore · Cloud Run (7 total)

✅ Features: Multi-turn conversational Panic Mode · Live agent thinking panel (SSE) · Real-time task dashboard · Proactive nudge system · Google Calendar auto-scheduling · Notification center · Settings with preference persistence

Live: zerohour-a84d3.web.app | GitHub: github.com/PG300604/ZeroHour

title: SkillShare
longDescription:
A full-stack web application that connects users with nearby collaborators based on shared skills — think Tinder, but for learning and building together.
Backend: Built with Spring Boot (Java 17) and secured using OAuth2 JWT authentication via Supabase as the identity provider. Designed a geolocation-based matching engine using the Haversine formula with dynamic radius expansion — starting at a 10km search radius and progressively expanding to 100km — ranking results by skill proficiency scores.
Database: Spring Data JPA + Hibernate with PostgreSQL in production and H2 for local development. Schema managed via JPA DDL auto with seed data via SQL scripts.
Frontend: React (Vite) with a swipe-card UI, real-time messaging, match overlays, and profile setup flows. Integrated Supabase for auth token management.
DevOps: Containerized the Spring Boot backend using a multi-stage Docker build (Maven build stage + lightweight JRE runtime stage). Frontend deployed on Vercel with CORS configured for cross-origin API calls.
🔧 Stack: Java · Spring Boot · Spring Security · OAuth2 · Hibernate/JPA · PostgreSQL · Docker · React · Maven · Supabase
